title: ID0418767-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S2 170003381] OMV- ELMS connectivity issue (C1)
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
A ticket is already open for the Charger. However, this has nothing to do with the 0kW sessions. The problem is that the charger is connected to an ELMS and as soon as the ELMS controller restarts, the charger cannot be reached for some time. It takes several hours until the connection is re-established. At the same time, the connection to other Alpitronic chargers is reestablished a few seconds after the reboot. So the fault lies with our charger and not with the ELMS controller. see e.g. 04.04.2025
